name: 12 Nữ Thần
source:
Biden (name changeable) - a 69-year-old man, put on headphones and hid in his house to watch JAV as usual.

BOOM! A plane crashed into the old man's house. he died. Old Biden's soul flew through time and space.

When he opened his eyes, he found himself lying under a cliff, in the body of a weak and small teenager. He has transmigrated into another world!

[From [url=https://hkproduction.itch.io/12-goddesses]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
69岁的老人拜登（姓名可更改），像往常一样戴上耳机，躲在家里观看日本成人影片。

轰！一架飞机撞进了老人的房子。他死了，而老拜登的灵魂穿越了时空。

当他睁开眼睛时，发现自己躺在悬崖下，身处一具瘦弱少年的身体之中。他竟然穿越到了另一个世界！

[摘自[url=https://hkproduction.itch.io/12-goddesses]Itch.io[/url]]
